name: neon-postgres
description: Manage Neon Serverless Postgres projects and databases with the neon-postgres agent skill and the Neon MCP Server

shortDescription.en-US: Manage Neon Serverless Postgres projects and databases
shortDescription.zh-CN: 管理 Neon Serverless Postgres 项目和数据库

longDescription.en-US: Use the Neon Postgres plugin to create and manage Neon Serverless Postgres projects and databases. Includes the Neon MCP Server for project and database management, and the neon-postgres skill with guides on connection methods, branching, autoscaling, Neon Auth, and more.
longDescription.zh-CN: 使用 Neon Postgres 插件创建和管理 Neon Serverless Postgres 项目和数据库。包含用于项目和数据库管理的 Neon MCP Server，以及涵盖连接方式、分支、自动扩缩容、Neon Auth 等内容的 neon-postgres skill。

defaultPrompt: Use Neon to create a new Serverless Postgres database for my project and help me connect to it.

skillPreviews.name: neon-postgres
skillPreviews.description: Guides and best practices for working with Neon Serverless Postgres. Covers getting started, local development with Neon, choosing a connection method, Neon features, authentication (@neondatabase/auth), PostgREST-style data API (@neondatabase/neon-js), Neon CLI, and Neon's Platform API/SDKs. Use for any Neon-related questions.
